stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “In health class, students learned how vaccines train the body to recognize certain diseases.”?
options: Each week, they examined a popular claim heard online or around school.
After a beloved teacher passed away, former students created an online memorial page.
Some students had heard confusing claims online.
The students learned that music is not only something found online.
